prompt: My agent is loading far too many StackOne tools and the context is huge. How do I limit which actions are exposed, or discover the right tool at run time instead of loading everything?
skill_note: Tool discovery and context size are agents territory.

fetch.name: fetches-tool-search-or-scoping-docs
fetch.note: Advanced Tool Search, Tool Discovery or Scoping Connectors.

reply.name: mentions-search-or-scoping
reply.note: The two documented levers: search-based discovery and scoping the profile.

reference: Scope the connector profile to only the actions the app uses; that limits every linked account on the profile and shrinks the tool set.
Use tool search: discover the right action by natural language at run time and then execute it, instead of loading every tool definition into context.
Loading hundreds of tool definitions burns tokens and hurts tool selection accuracy, which is why the docs recommend search-based discovery.
